tools.name: bdk_whoami
tools.description: Read the signed-in user and their projects; call first. product_selected can be an unconfirmed default. Legacy status is not ledger entitlement; use bdk_next.commerce.

tools.name: bdk_projects
tools.description: List projects or read a status/progress/health snapshot, not full settings or credentials. Use bdk_next.commerce for ledger entitlement and current requests. Do not infer payment or delivery from legacy status, paid_for_service, requested_build, build_complete, rebuild_credits or free_rebuild_expire

tools.name: bdk_next
tools.description: Read workflow state and next steps; call again after each action. confirm_product writes and records the customer-confirmed iOS / Android / Both choice: ask first. Checkout requires recorded confirmation matching the saved platform, even when the saved default already matches the customer's choice.

tools.name: bdk_create_project
tools.description: Create a project after approval of the reference label and published app URL. project_name is a reference label, not the home-screen app name; that starts as the website hostname until configured. Duplicates by reference label or site host return candidates: ask the customer to choose create_new or

tools.name: bdk_configure
tools.description: Fetch https://thebdk.com/agent/skill.md and apply only its documented writable fields after approval. Set tnc_accepted:true only after explicit acceptance of https://thebdk.com/terms for this project. launch_link changes installed apps: obtain approval for the exact URL. push_prompt_mode is automati

tools.name: bdk_upload
tools.description: Import a direct public HTTPS PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 8 MB, without redirects; this does not assign a screen. Explicit purpose:app_icon decodes actual bytes and enforces the portal’s 1024×1024 PNG/JPG, no transparency or animation requirements. Omitted purpose or purpose:image accepts other ima

tools.name: bdk_setup_preview
tools.description: Creation requires intent:new; legacy app_link + preview_id updates that selected preview. list returns account preview names, published URLs, IDs and creation times. new calls the portal preview-manage create path (same-URL reuse and 20-preview cap); update requires the customer-selected preview_id

tools.name: bdk_estimate
tools.description: With project_code, verify access and read ledger offers; report lookup failure rather than substituting a standard quote. A legacy project without product returns legacy_project; with product, it returns standard prices. Without project_code, product also selects standard prices, not eligibility. of

tools.name: bdk_check
tools.description: Read health checks and health_checked_at, not build execution status. run:true schedules an asynchronous check. If scheduled, re-read without run after a minute. If not scheduled, say so and use the portal. A passing check is an observation, not compatibility or store approval.

tools.name: bdk_checkout
tools.description: Start or poll a project purchase only after purchase approval. First read bdk_next.commerce and confirm the customer’s platform via bdk_next confirm_product; a default Both is not consent. Checkout requires recorded platform confirmation and refuses purchases when an unused entitlement or active req

tools.name: bdk_build
tools.description: Request a build or rebuild only after explicit approval of that request and the saved settings. A first build requires confirm_build:true after the customer says yes. A ledger rebuild consumes one banked rebuild: pass build_kind:rebuild and confirm_consumes_rebuild:true. free_rebuild is legacy-only.

tools.name: bdk_login
tools.description: Start a device code for an additional HTTP client from an already authenticated MCP session. This MCP session cannot redeem that code through a tool. For initial or expired MCP authentication, use the host reconnect flow. For HTTP device flow, follow https://thebdk.com/agent/skill.md.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bdk_create_project, bdk_configure, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_estimate, bdk_checkout, bdk_build · Private data: bdk_projects, bdk_next, bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_build · Public sink: bdk_next, bdk_create_project, bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_build · Destructive: bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bdk_create_project, bdk_configure, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_estimate, bdk_checkout, bdk_build · Private data: bdk_projects, bdk_next, bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_build · Public sink: bdk_next, bdk_create_project, bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_build · Destructive: bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
